items: data mining — Finding patterns in datasets.
scatter plot — Pairs of numeric variables plotted as points.
correlation — Association, not proof of causation.

blocks.title: Define and predict
blocks.text: Data mining seeks patterns or associations across sets of data; define the question, prepare records and examine the results.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Visualisation makes patterns and anomalies visible. Scatter charts suit pairs of numeric data; bar charts compare categories.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: A correlation does not establish cause. Sampling, confounders, missing values and measurement choices may mislead interpretation.
